page.overview:
What is Foxy the Pirate?

Foxy is one of the animatronics in the Five Nights at Freddy's novel trilogy. He is an entertainer of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza created by Henry Emily. Foxy appears an antagonist and supporting character in the first two novels respectively.

Foxy's appearance is similar to his game counterpart. He is a large pirate fox with a rotting eyepatch over one of his plastic silver eyes and a large, sharpened metal hook for a hand. Foxy's narrow, reddish face is a canine rictus with a snout and ghoulish smile. His robotic endoskeleton is encased in hollow body parts matted with dark red fur, but only from the knees up. Foxy's scrappy fur does not sufficiently cover his skull, and there are also areas on his body where the metal is exposed.

In The Twisted Ones, Foxy appears more withered and dirty, with his fur covering ripped in more places. John can see more of his endoskeleton than before.

Foxy resided in his own special party room at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, a popular restaurant in Hurricane, Utah opened by business partners Henry Emily and William Afton. He could be found in Pirate's Cove, which was typically out of order. Henry's daughter, Charlie, was afraid of Foxy however and always hid under the tables. When five children had disappeared at the restaurant in 1985, it was closed down and construction began on a mall. The mall was built over Freddy's but never finished, abandoned for the next ten years.
